item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:30 HKT 05/Nov/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A weak cold front is expected to form over central China today, and reach the coast of southern China tomorrow. There will be a few showers over the region. Under the influence of the associated northeast monsoon, it will be windier and slightly cooler with one or two rain patches over the coastal areas midweek this week.

Date/Month: 05/11 (Sunday)
Wind: East force 2 to 3.
Weather: Mainly fine. Becoming cloudy with isolated showers later.
Temp range: 25 - 30 C
R.H. range: 65 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
